title: Update release configuration when a new npm workspace package appears
prompt: We added @acme/extra to this workspace. Update monochange so both public packages are release-managed independently, retaining our custom verify-local workflow, parent_bump policy, and configuration comments. Record a patch for the new package. Existing configuration must be updated in place rather than regenerated with --force. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: An agent discovers the new package, adds its quoted npm declaration without replacing customer config, and produces an independent 2.0.1 release plan for @acme/extra.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.deepEqual(c.packages.map(p=>[p.id,p.package_type]).sort(),[["@acme/extra","npm"],["@acme/public","npm"]]); assert.equal(c.defaults.parent_bump,"none");'
checks.why: Newly added manifests need explicit release ownership while existing policy stays intact.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.released_packages,["@acme/extra"]); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>[t.id,t.version]),[["@acme/extra","2.0.1"]]);'
checks.why: The new package release must not drag the existing independent package along.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; assert.match(fs.readFileSync("monochange.toml","utf8"),/# Customer workflow: preserve this policy/); assert.match(cli(["run","verify-local"]),/preserved-workflow/);'
checks.why: Regenerating with init --force would silently discard a customer workflow.
The user explicitly requires an in-place config update.
